title: Mitigate intermittent token-throughput variance impacting TTFT across Hosted/Dedicated/Private
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Multiple customers reported sudden degradations in tokens/sec and first-token latency (TTFT) for mid-to-long context workloads across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Investigation shows a noisy interaction between the kernel-selection heuristic and KV-prefetch thresholds when context windows exceed 8k tokens for quantized variants. This ticket tracks the triage, immediate hotfixes (canary + patch), customer communications, and follow-ups for a permanent fix.
comments: 2026-03-12 09:18 - Aisha Kumar: Customer A and B escalated via Support at 08:45 UTC. Alerting dashboard shows ~30% drop in tokens/sec and 2–3x increase in TTFT on replicas serving quantized-8bit variants for models m-open-3b and m-open-13b at longer contexts.

2026-03-12 11:05 - On-call Eng: Reproduced locally with stress harness (multi-tenant mix, long-context prompts). Observed kernel selector choosing fallback kernels with higher per-token latency when prefetch triggered mid-request. KV cache churn correlates with prefetch windows.

2026-03-12 13:40 - Liam O'Connor: Added detailed flamegraph and perf traces to Confluence. Initial hypothesis: race between prefetch/kv-eviction and kernel-capacity-estimation path causing suboptimal kernel switch mid-stream leading to pipeline stalls.
2026-03-12 16:12 - PM (Riley Zhang): Notifying top-affected customers with mitigation timeline. Marking customer_impact=high. Coordinating Dedicated account teams for immediate patch windows.

2026-03-13 02:30 - Engineering: Implemented kernel-selector pin override for affected variants and reduced prefetch window from 500ms to 150ms in canary. Canary on 0.5% traffic for Hosted in us-west2 and one Dedicated cluster. Early signals: tokens/sec recovered to baseline, TTFT down by ~35% compared to degraded state.
2026-03-13 09:00 - Security: Reviewed change; no secrets or policy changes. security_review_required=false.
2026-03-13 14:22 - Customer Success: Customer A confirmed improvement in Canary; requesting Dedicated patch schedule next 24h window.

2026-03-14 07:50 - Liam O'Connor: Rolling hotfix to remaining Hosted clusters (gradual ramp) and pushing patch bundle for Dedicated clusters. Private customers notified with a hotfix package and manual upgrade instructions.
2026-03-14 10:15 - QA: Regression tests added for mid-long context workloads, stress harness scenario id: st-2026-888.

2026-03-14 12:40 - Follow-ups captured: implement kernel-selection backpressure metric, add unit tests for prefetch heuristics, and schedule deeper root-cause analysis to avoid future mid-request kernel switches.
